prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1097; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision referenced in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please let us know immediately.

We request that you disclose the full bodily injury and property damage liability limits of every policy that may apply to this loss, including any umbrella or excess coverage, along with the declarations page for each. Please provide this information within fifteen days of receipt of this letter.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes claim notes, recorded statements, photographs, surveillance or dash camera footage, adjuster and appraiser reports, vehicle inspection records, and any electronic data associated with the claim. Destruction or alteration of such materials may result in sanctions in any litigation that follows.

We look forward to your prompt response.
